rationale: Restores per-pass Yoga node ownership in core/view, reverting the retained-tree change registered as 20260909-yoga-tree-reuse-watch. That event asserted unchanged layout results by construction; a reuse-versus-fresh differential test contradicts it on 25 of 240 randomised mutation steps, and the retained-tree lifetime additionally frees the outer pass's nodes when layout re-enters on a nested root, which segfaults under test. Touching render-assets-and-backends is core/view only. No renderer, backend, font, asset or Skia pin changes; no harness, fixture, snapshot or threshold changes. Registered as watch-only so the family's coverage stays honest about a change that crossed its selector. No authority moves and no Vellum artifact changes.
